Priya (CSM): Heads-up — prepping a 30‑min runway snapshot for Atum ahead of renewal next week. Need token burn, 90/30 day trend, and top 3 cost ops asks. Can someone pull spend slices?
Jordan - FinOps: I can pull. sending daily breakdown now — will attach CSV link in a sec.
Alex G: Quick ask — include embedding-heavy routes — they had a 4x spike on /embed last week.
Jordan - FinOps: noted. running `redwood billing --account=atum --range=90d --granularity=day --breakdown=route`
Alex G: thx. if numbers show >25% month-over-month increase, we flag for throttle and add to QBR risk slide.
Priya (CSM): Also capture onboarding milestones — devs still in staging; any credit cushion left?
María (Acct Owner): They used ~60% of trial credits, ~10k tokens left. I'll ping product contact for cleanup and dev prioritization.
Priya (CSM): Can we propose 2 mitigations for the QBR: (1) ephemeral prefix/KV caching for the chat flow, (2) recommend 8-bit quant model for embeddings and a warmed cache. Need cost delta estimates.
Jordan - FinOps: I'll produce delta numbers (expected savings + perf tradeoffs). ETA EOD.
Alex G: For the deck: include action items, expected monthly savings, and the risk if we do nothing (projected over 30/90d).
OnboardBot: Reminder: Atum onboarding status -> Staging (integration tests failing), last contact 3 days ago.
Priya (CSM): Also capture customer feedback bullets: latency on multi-turn chat, unpredictable token spikes when they bulk-index documents.
María (Acct Owner): I'll chase engineering lead and pull sample logs + call traces to include in appendices.
Priya (CSM): Owners for next steps: Jordan (cost numbers & thresholds), Alex (technical mitigations + throttle cutoffs), María (customer outreach & logs). Let's meet 9 AM PST tomorrow to finalize the slide. :calendar:
Alex G: +1
Jordan - FinOps: +1
María (Acct Owner): +1
Priya (CSM): Copying internal QBR slide template: https://redwood.app/sales/qbr-template — use section "Spend & Risks" and add a one‑pager of recommended guardrails.
Alex G: putting a small command snippet to fetch last 30 days top routes:
```bash
redwood api usage list --account=atum --period=30d --top=10 > atum-top30.csv
```
Priya (CSM): Perfect. I'll synthesize into one-slide ask + next-step checklist and share draft before the morning sync. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
